title: Jaipur destination guide
body: Jaipur (Pink City) highlights: Amber Fort (poi_jaipur_amber), Hawa Mahal (poi_jaipur_hawa), City Palace. Best months: October–February per city_jaipur. Heritage walks in Old City; mid stays e.g. stay_jaipur_mid_01 in Bani Park/Old City — use tools for indicative prices. [cite:doc_dest_jaipur_guide_v1]

title: Goa destination guide
body: Goa combines north beaches (Baga poi_goa_baga) with Old Goa churches (poi_goa_old). Peak beach season November–February. Mix relaxed beach days with heritage; costs are indicative only. [cite:doc_dest_goa_guide_v1]

title: Manali destination guide
body: Manali base for Solang Valley (poi_manali_solang) and Hadimba Temple. Adventure and snow season varies; March–June popular. Mountain drives from Delhi are long — compare train/bus/road modes in tools. [cite:doc_dest_manali_guide_v1]

title: Kochi destination guide
body: Kochi / Kerala gateway: Fort Kochi heritage (poi_kochi_fort), backwater cruises (poi_kochi_backwater). October–January weather is pleasant. Seafood and homestays; numeric fees via poi records. [cite:doc_dest_kochi_guide_v1]

title: Delhi destination guide
body: Delhi capital circuit: Qutub Minar (poi_delhi_qutub), Red Fort (poi_delhi_redfort). Metro-friendly; pair with Agra weekend trips. Summer heat severe May–June. [cite:doc_dest_delhi_guide_v1]

title: Bangalore destination guide
body: Bengaluru urban breaks and weekend hops (Mysore hold-out nearby). Lalbagh (poi_bangalore_lalbagh) for half-day green escape. Transit hub for Kochi/Goa flights — indicative only. [cite:doc_dest_bangalore_guide_v1]

title: Mumbai destination guide
body: Mumbai: Gateway of India (poi_mumbai_gateway), Marine Drive (poi_mumbai_marine). Coastal humidity year-round; November–February milder. Premium tier destination in KB. [cite:doc_dest_mumbai_guide_v1]

title: Shimla destination guide
body: Shimla hill station: Mall Road (poi_shimla_mall), Kufri excursion (poi_shimla_kufri). Family-friendly; winter cold. Road from Delhi via Chandigarh — see route tools. [cite:doc_dest_shimla_guide_v1]

title: Rishikesh destination guide
body: Rishikesh: rafting (poi_rishikesh_rafting), Laxman Jhula (poi_rishikesh_laxman). Spiritual and adventure mix; budget stays e.g. stay_rishikesh_bud_01. Avoid peak monsoon rafting assumptions. [cite:doc_dest_rishikesh_guide_v1]

title: Agra destination guide
body: Agra for Taj Mahal (poi_agra_taj) and Agra Fort (poi_agra_fort). Often 1–2 day extension from Delhi. Sunrise Taj visits recommended; fees via poi fee_band_inr in tools. [cite:doc_dest_agra_guide_v1]

title: Nahargarh Fort — visitor card
body: Nahargarh Fort (poi_jaipur_nahargarh) category=fort, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Built in 1734 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, this fort offers the best panoramic views of Jaipur city and Mansagar Lake. Popular for sunset views. Entry fee indicative. [cite:doc_poi_jaipur_nahargarh_v1]

title: Albert Hall Museum — visitor card
body: Albert Hall Museum (poi_jaipur_albert) category=museum, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. The oldest museum in Rajasthan, built in 1887 in Indo-Saracenic style. Houses Egyptian mummies, miniature paintings, carpets, and royal artifacts. Entry fee indicative. [cite:doc_poi_jaipur_albert_v1]

title: Jal Mahal — visitor card
body: Jal Mahal (poi_jaipur_jal_mahal) category=landmark, typical_duration_hrs=0.5. The Water Palace appears to float on Man Sagar Lake. Best viewed from the lakeside road at sunset. Interior not open to public. Free to view from outside. [cite:doc_poi_jaipur_jal_mahal_v1]

title: Anjuna Beach and Flea Market — visitor card
body: Anjuna Beach (poi_goa_anjuna) category=beach, typical_duration_hrs=3.0. Famous for its Wednesday flea market selling handicrafts, clothes, and souvenirs. Rocky beach with a bohemian vibe. Best for sunset and nightlife. Free entry. [cite:doc_poi_goa_anjuna_v1]

title: Calangute Beach — visitor card
body: Calangute Beach (poi_goa_calangute) category=beach, typical_duration_hrs=2.5. The Queen of Beaches — Goa largest and most popular beach. Water sports, beach shacks, and vibrant atmosphere. Best October to March. Free entry. [cite:doc_poi_goa_calangute_v1]

title: Panjim City and Latin Quarter — visitor card
body: Panjim (poi_goa_panjim) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Goa capital with colorful Portuguese-era houses in Fontainhas Latin Quarter. Church of Our Lady of Immaculate Conception is iconic. Great for heritage walks and local cuisine. Free to explore. [cite:doc_poi_goa_panjim_v1]

title: Chapora Fort — visitor card
body: Chapora Fort (poi_goa_chapora) category=fort, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. 17th-century Portuguese fort made famous by Dil Chahta Hai. Offers stunning views of Vagator Beach and the Arabian Sea. Free entry. Best at sunset. [cite:doc_poi_goa_chapora_v1]

title: Spice Plantation Tour — visitor card
body: Spice Plantation Tour (poi_goa_spice) category=nature, typical_duration_hrs=3.0. Guided tours through cardamom, pepper, vanilla, and cashew plantations in Ponda. Includes traditional Goan lunch. Entry fee indicative ~600 INR. [cite:doc_poi_goa_spice_v1]

title: Rohtang Pass — visitor card
body: Rohtang Pass (poi_manali_rohtang) category=nature, typical_duration_hrs=6.0. High mountain pass at 3,978m on the Manali-Leh highway. Snow-covered most of the year. Requires permit (NGT). Best May to October. Entry fee indicative ~550 INR. [cite:doc_poi_manali_rohtang_v1]

title: Old Manali and Manu Temple — visitor card
body: Old Manali (poi_manali_old) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Charming village with cafes, guesthouses, and the ancient Manu Rishi Temple. Great for leisurely walks along the Manalsu stream. Free to explore. [cite:doc_poi_manali_old_v1]

title: Naggar Castle — visitor card
body: Naggar Castle (poi_manali_naggar) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. 500-year-old castle built by Raja Sidh Singh in European-Himalayan style. Now a heritage hotel. Houses the Nicholas Roerich Art Gallery. Entry fee indicative ~100 INR. [cite:doc_poi_manali_naggar_v1]

title: Mattancherry Palace — visitor card
body: Mattancherry Palace (poi_kochi_mattancherry) category=museum, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. Also called Dutch Palace, built by Portuguese in 1555. Famous for Kerala murals depicting Ramayana and Mahabharata. Entry fee indicative ~10 INR. [cite:doc_poi_kochi_mattancherry_v1]

title: Paradesi Synagogue — visitor card
body: Paradesi Synagogue (poi_kochi_synagogue) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=1.0. Built in 1568, one of the oldest active synagogues in the Commonwealth. Famous for hand-painted Chinese floor tiles. Entry fee indicative ~10 INR. Closed Saturdays. [cite:doc_poi_kochi_synagogue_v1]

title: Cherai Beach — visitor card
body: Cherai Beach (poi_kochi_cherai) category=beach, typical_duration_hrs=3.0. Pristine 15km beach on Vypeen Island, 25km from Kochi. Unique combination of sea and backwaters. Dolphins sometimes spotted. Free entry. Best October to March. [cite:doc_poi_kochi_cherai_v1]

title: India Gate — visitor card
body: India Gate (poi_delhi_india_gate) category=landmark, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. 42m war memorial on Kartavya Path (formerly Rajpath). Eternal flame burns at Amar Jawan Jyoti. Surrounded by lawns popular for evening walks. Free entry. [cite:doc_poi_delhi_india_gate_v1]

title: Humayun Tomb — visitor card
body: Humayun Tomb (poi_delhi_humayun) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. UNESCO World Heritage Site built in 1570. First garden-tomb in the Indian subcontinent, precursor to the Taj Mahal. Entry fee indicative ~40 INR. [cite:doc_poi_delhi_humayun_v1]

title: Lotus Temple — visitor card
body: Lotus Temple (poi_delhi_lotus) category=temple, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. Bahai House of Worship shaped like a lotus flower. Open to all religions. Serene and architecturally stunning. Free entry. Closed Mondays. [cite:doc_poi_delhi_lotus_v1]

title: Chandni Chowk and Old Delhi — visitor card
body: Chandni Chowk (poi_delhi_chandni) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=3.0. 17th-century market near Red Fort. Famous for street food (paranthas, jalebis), spice market, and wholesale bazaars. Best explored by cycle rickshaw. Free to explore. [cite:doc_poi_delhi_chandni_v1]

title: Fatehpur Sikri — visitor card
body: Fatehpur Sikri (poi_agra_fatehpur) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=3.0. UNESCO World Heritage Site, 16th-century Mughal capital built by Akbar. Includes Buland Darwaza, Jama Masjid, and Panch Mahal. 40km from Agra. Entry fee indicative ~40 INR. [cite:doc_poi_agra_fatehpur_v1]

title: Mehtab Bagh — visitor card
body: Mehtab Bagh (poi_agra_mehtab) category=nature, typical_duration_hrs=1.0. Moonlight Garden across the Yamuna from the Taj Mahal. Best spot for Taj Mahal sunset views and photography. Entry fee indicative ~25 INR. [cite:doc_poi_agra_mehtab_v1]

title: Itimad-ud-Daulah — visitor card
body: Itimad-ud-Daulah (poi_agra_itimad) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. Called Baby Taj, built 1622-1628. First Mughal structure built entirely of marble with pietra dura inlay. Entry fee indicative ~30 INR. [cite:doc_poi_agra_itimad_v1]

title: Triveni Ghat Aarti — visitor card
body: Triveni Ghat (poi_rishikesh_triveni) category=temple, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. Sacred bathing ghat where three rivers meet. Evening Ganga Aarti at sunset is spectacular. Free to attend. Best at 6pm daily. [cite:doc_poi_rishikesh_triveni_v1]

title: Beatles Ashram — visitor card
body: Beatles Ashram (poi_rishikesh_beatles) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Maharishi Mahesh Yogi ashram where The Beatles stayed in 1968. Now an open-air art gallery with murals. Entry fee indicative ~150 INR. [cite:doc_poi_rishikesh_beatles_v1]

title: Yoga and Meditation Session — visitor card
body: Yoga Session (poi_rishikesh_yoga) category=wellness, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Rishikesh is the Yoga Capital of the World. Hundreds of ashrams offer classes. Indicative fee ~500 INR per session. Best booked in advance. [cite:doc_poi_rishikesh_yoga_v1]

title: Jakhu Temple and Ropeway — visitor card
body: Jakhu Temple (poi_shimla_jakhu) category=temple, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Ancient Hanuman temple at 2455m, highest point in Shimla. 33m Hanuman statue visible from the city. Ropeway available. Entry fee indicative ~250 INR for ropeway. [cite:doc_poi_shimla_jakhu_v1]

title: Viceregal Lodge — visitor card
body: Viceregal Lodge (poi_shimla_viceregal) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. Built in 1888 as summer residence of British Viceroys. Now Indian Institute of Advanced Study. Tudor-style architecture. Entry fee indicative ~50 INR. [cite:doc_poi_shimla_viceregal_v1]

title: Kalka-Shimla Toy Train — visitor card
body: Kalka-Shimla Toy Train (poi_shimla_toy_train) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=5.0. UNESCO World Heritage narrow-gauge railway through 102 tunnels and 864 bridges. Scenic 96km journey. Entry fee indicative ~400 INR. Book in advance. [cite:doc_poi_shimla_toy_train_v1]

title: Elephanta Caves — visitor card
body: Elephanta Caves (poi_mumbai_elephanta) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=4.0. UNESCO World Heritage Site on Elephanta Island. 5th-7th century rock-cut cave temples dedicated to Shiva. Ferry from Gateway of India. Entry fee indicative ~600 INR including ferry. [cite:doc_poi_mumbai_elephanta_v1]

title: Colaba Causeway — visitor card
body: Colaba Causeway (poi_mumbai_colaba) category=leisure, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Iconic shopping street near Gateway of India. Antiques, clothes, street food, and the historic Taj Mahal Palace Hotel. Free to explore. [cite:doc_poi_mumbai_colaba_v1]

title: Dharavi Heritage Walk — visitor card
body: Dharavi Heritage Walk (poi_mumbai_dharavi) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=2.5. Guided walk through Asia largest urban settlement. Showcases recycling industries, pottery, leather, and bakeries. Entry fee indicative ~800 INR. [cite:doc_poi_mumbai_dharavi_v1]

title: Juhu Beach — visitor card
body: Juhu Beach (poi_mumbai_juhu) category=beach, typical_duration_hrs=2.0. Popular beach in north Mumbai famous for street food — pav bhaji, bhel puri, and vada pav. Sunset views. Free entry. [cite:doc_poi_mumbai_juhu_v1]

title: Cubbon Park — visitor card
body: Cubbon Park (poi_bangalore_cubbon) category=park, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. 300-acre green lung of Bengaluru with 6,000+ trees. Houses the State Central Library and Attara Kacheri. Free entry. Best for morning walks. [cite:doc_poi_bangalore_cubbon_v1]

title: Tipu Sultan Summer Palace — visitor card
body: Tipu Sultan Summer Palace (poi_bangalore_tipu) category=heritage, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. 18th-century Indo-Islamic palace built by Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan. Intricate teak woodwork and frescoes. Entry fee indicative ~15 INR. [cite:doc_poi_bangalore_tipu_v1]

title: ISKCON Temple Bangalore — visitor card
body: ISKCON Temple (poi_bangalore_iskcon) category=temple, typical_duration_hrs=1.5. One of the largest ISKCON temples in the world. Stunning architecture with gold-plated domes. Free entry. Evening aarti at 7pm is spectacular. [cite:doc_poi_bangalore_iskcon_v1]
